messages:
paul: Heads-up 1: recruiters flagged ~20 interviews this morning with blank scorecards after the ATS webhook started returning 202 without mapping. Can we triage?

anya: ugh, saw that on the QA dashboard. Likely the mapping service timed out. I'll pull an export and validate which roles are affected.

kevin: plan: dry-run backfill that only writes scorecard_id when empty, post a CSV sample, then apply. I'll include a Slack alert if >10 updates.

recruiting-bot: export queued (job=130201). ETA 45s.

anya: export done: 19 rows. sample: C-1101 INT-480 role=Backend IC2 created_by=loop-recruiter -> no scorecard_id.

paul: please don't run apply until I confirm role mappings for Platform/SRE. Last time a backfill swapped panel types for senior roles.

kevin: dry-run command I used:

```
python tools/ats_backfill.py --csv /tmp/missing_scorecards.csv --dry-run --set scorecard_id=panel-tech-v2
```

dry-run: 19 rows would be updated, no conflicts.

anya: checked mappings: only IC1-IC3 backend and frontend affected. safe to proceed.

paul: approved. kevin, run apply and post CSV + log snippet here.

recruiting-bot: backfill started (job=130202).

kevin: apply complete. job=130202 updated 19 interviews. log snippet: `2026-03-14T10:12:03Z INFO updated INT-480 scorecard_id=panel-tech-v2`

anya: spot-checked 5 interviews, scorecards attached and scoring sections visible.

paul: follow-ups: 1) schedule a 20-min rubric refresh for interviewers on the new fields; 2) add a nightly QA that alerts if any interviews are created with empty scorecard_id. I'll create the invite and ticket.

kevin: will add the QA alert to the backfill workflow. closing once invite sent. :white_check_mark:
